integrity: Derived from the explicit algorithm in arXiv:2610.11425v1, using exact arithmetic and standard local stable-manifold theory; no claims of independent validation or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar three-periodic strongly convex quadratic objectives with the source APG2 step n=1 and compact interval. The equality case s=7/64 has a -1 linear multiplier and nonlinear stability is not characterized. Instability means local finite-time neighborhood exit, not global divergence or asymptotic failure of all starts. Historical literature comparisons are not exhaustive.
title: A sharp three-round Floquet threshold for state-dependent time-varying proximal acceleration
